chunks: Remember, We gave Moses the Book and Discernment, that you may be guided.

key_terms.وَالْفُرْقَانَ: The Criterion (that which distinguishes truth from falsehood)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Al-Furqan given to Moses in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual nature of divine guidance: the written Scripture (Al-Kitab) and the distinguishing criterion (Al-Furqan) that clarifies truth from falsehood. This bestowal upon Prophet Moses (AS) serves as a foundational precedent for the ultimate guidance offered through the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that true guidance requires both textual revelation and the intellectual capacity to discern its deeper meanings.
